verdict.rationale: EBANX documents a hosted checkout page that it manages: the merchant sends payment parameters and EBANX handles the full payment flow, including UI, validation and processing. That delivers the core of the story without building your own payment UI. A no-code payment-link option is also documented. Missing for 10: evidence that the page is conversion-optimized, detailed redirect/return-URL mechanics documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can redirect customers to a vendor-hosted, conversion-optimized checkout page without building my own payment UI

citations.quote: Hosted checkout page managed by EBANX. You send the payment parameters, and EBANX handles the full payment flow, including UI, validation, and processing.
No-code solution where payments are created via the EBANX dashboard and shared directly with customers through a link.
